ns2:section.sectionText: The course introduces education theories related to learning and conceptual change. Students will learn and apply qualitative methods for exploring student difficulties with a particular topic in CS. The course will involve writing a conference-style research paper based upon interview data collected within the course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, NDEG:Computer Science Onl-UIUC, or MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC.
